spans.s:
अब्ज अब्-ज, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. अप् and rt. जन्),
born in water; (अस्), m. the conch; the moon; the
tree Barringtonia Acutangula; Dhanvantari, physician
of the gods, produced at the churning of the ocean;
N. of a son of Viśala; (अम्), n. a lotus; a large
number of millions.
—अब्ज-ज, अस्, m. an epithet of
Brahmā (sprung at the creation from the lotus,
which arose from the navel of Viṣṇu).
—अब्ज-दृश्,
क्, क्, क्, or अब्ज-नयन, अस्, आ, अम्, or अब्ज-नेत्र,
अस्, आ, अम्, lotus-eyed, having large fine eyes.
—अब्ज-
बान्धव, अस्, m. the sun (friend of the lotus).
—अब्ज-भव, अस्, m. Brahmā, a Brāhman.
—अब्ज-
भोग, अस्, m. the root of a lotus.
—अब्ज-योनि, इस्,
m. epithet of Brahmā [cf. अब्ज-ज].
—अब्ज-वाहन,
अस्, m. epithet of Śiva, ‘carrying the moon’ on his
forehead.
—अब्ज-हस्त, अस्, m. the sun (represented
as holding a lotus in one hand).

2. अब्ज, Nom. P. अब्जति, &c., to become a lotus
flower.
अब्-जा, आस्, m., Ved. born in water.

अब्जिनी, f. a multitude of lotus flowers.
—अब्जिनी-
पति, इस्, m. the sun.

अब्जस् अब्जस्, अस्, n. shape, beauty [cf.
अप्सस्].

अब्जित् अब्-जित्, त्, त्, त् (fr. अप् and rt. जि),
Ved. conquering waters.
